name: Maken Wilhelm
source: The person inside the cursed sword that Lan carries. He usually sleeps inside the cursed sword and wakes only on occasion. He is quite belligerent and extreme, leading him to make unconventional remarks. He mocks the protagonist as the weakest wielder of the sword in history.
